name: EPIC 248870156
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 8.0 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,068 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.88 solar masses and 8.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,733 K at its surface.
